title: 第五章 物资进山第六章 准备和谈
content_zh:
清晨阳光不燥，微风正好。
十几亩田地之中，师兄弟二人正小心的在里面清除着杂草，甚至旁边还放着两个藤编的大筐。
宋风一边用手中的锄头轻轻地敲着旁边的偏僻坡地，一边小心地呼吸吐纳，生怕手上力气用的大了。
“铿锵！”
一声闷响突然响起，随即宋风只感觉手上微微一麻，向着下面看去，只看到他刨的那个地方正有一大堆石头在底下垫着。
杂草无数，到处都是小虫子。
底下各种石头都有，甚至一不小心还能翻出一坨盘着的毒蛇来。
“开垦土地真是越来越费劲了，贫道这一身筋骨，也不知道还能不能再为你们留下两亩薄田。”
看看锄头，发现锄头上面没有太过明显的痕迹，宋风则是并未向下刨土，而是小心的拿出镐子把那石头从里面掘出来。
那一块大石头百十斤，就只是将这石头敲碎弄下去，那也得花好长时间，在山上开出一亩田这难度可是太大了。
毒虫猛兽不说，只是一大堆垫在底下的石头，还有各种草根杂树，就还得清理好几年。
人工开垦土地，哪有那么简单。
“师父，要不您老就先休息休息吧，忙了大半辈子了，咱们的日子也是肉眼可见的好起来了。”
“听外面的建筑工人说，外界的朝廷要给咱们发现好多粮草来，专门要给咱们扶持替咱们修路呢。”
说到这里的时候，老大宋诚则是将割下来的诸多野草，毒虫之类的弄死，丢在旁边的筐子里，仔细看去，只看到这筐子里都是些小虫子，嫩草芽之类的。
老大之所以能够如此为秦正他们说话，也是秦正他们出了大力气使了钞能力了。
山林之中内外交通不连接。
就算是这些工程师在山中的生活照样也算是相对较为清苦。
但秦正他们前些时日也送来了一批物资，里面不仅有些粮食白面，甚至还有好多已经长大能够下蛋的鸡鸭。
求真观一连分到了六只大母鸡。

现如今老大宋诚每天要做的，除了是来地里弄除些青草之外，还要去山里割些杂草弄些虫子来喂鸡。
这些日子他们都吃上了鸡蛋了。
六只老母鸡供应好了，每天稳定最少下三个鸡蛋，这一番操作直接就把宋诚宋志他们师兄弟两个给忽悠住了。
对于外来的建筑工程师也没了敌意。
张口胡乱画饼的他们不喜欢，但是动不动就一批一批往里面运送白面粮食，还给鸡鸭鹅的建筑工程师，他们可太喜欢了。
现如今村子里都吃上了蒸馍馍。
家家户户都带着笑意。
日子是真的蒸蒸日上了，就连原本面上带着一些菜色的猎户农人，脸上也多了几分红润。
“咱们这穷山沟沟里就算是有外界补贴估计也不可能持续下去，打铁还得自身硬，家里有几亩薄田能自家供应吃喝，这才是根本。”
“说什么都是虚的，家里有吃的，手上有拳头，身上有甲胄，放在哪个时代都能站起来说句话。”
“当年你师祖他老人家能带着我来到这山村，能够安然的活下去，就是因为这三样，你们两个小的还是太嫩了。”
content_en:
The sun is not dry in the morning and the breeze is just right.
In a field of more than ten acres, the two brothers were carefully clearing weeds, and there were even two large rattan baskets placed next to them.
Song Feng gently tapped the remote slope next to him with the hoe in his hand, while breathing carefully, for fear that he would use too much strength on his hand.
"Clang!"
A muffled sound suddenly sounded, and then Song Feng felt a slight numbness in his hands. He looked down and saw a large pile of rocks underneath where he was digging.
There are countless weeds and bugs everywhere.
There are all kinds of rocks underneath, and you can even uncover a coiled venomous snake if you're not careful.
"It's getting more and more difficult to cultivate the land. I don't know if I can leave two acres of thin farmland for you with all my strength."
Looking at the hoe, he found that there were no obvious marks on the hoe. Song Feng did not dig down the soil, but carefully took out the pickaxe and dug out the stone from inside.
That big stone weighs 100 pounds. It would take a long time just to break it into pieces. It would be too difficult to carve out an acre of land on the mountain.
Not to mention poisonous insects and beasts, it is just a pile of stones and various grass roots and trees at the bottom, which will take several years to clear.
It is not that simple to reclaim land manually.
"Master, why don't you take some rest first? We have been busy for most of our lives, and our lives have obviously gotten better."
"I heard from the construction workers outside that the court from outside wants to find a lot of food and grass for us, and specifically wants to support us and build roads for us."
When talking about this, the boss Song Cheng killed many weeds, poisonous insects and the like, and threw them into the basket next to him. Looking carefully, he only saw that the basket was full of small insects, young grass sprouts and the like.
The reason why the boss was able to speak for Qin Zheng and the others in this way was because Qin Zheng and the others had made great efforts to use their money abilities.
There is no connection between internal and external transportation in the mountains and forests.
Even these engineers' life in the mountains is still relatively poor.
But Qin Zheng and the others also sent a batch of supplies a few days ago, which not only contained some grain and flour, but also many chickens and ducks that had grown up and were able to lay eggs.
Qiuzhen Guan was assigned six big hens in a row.
Nowadays, what the boss Song Cheng has to do every day is not only to come to the fields to remove some grass, but also to go to the mountains to cut some weeds and get some insects to feed the chickens.
They all eat eggs these days.
The supply of six old hens was ready, and they would steadily lay at least three eggs every day. This operation directly fooled Song Cheng and Song Zhi's two senior brothers.
There is no hostility towards foreign construction engineers.
They don't like the people who open their mouths and draw cakes randomly, but they like the construction engineers who always transport batches of flour inside and return them to chickens, ducks and geese.
Nowadays, everyone in the village eats steamed buns.
Every household is smiling.
The days are really getting better and better, and even the Orion farmer, who originally had some food on his face, has a little more rosy face.
"Even with external subsidies, we probably won't be able to survive in this poor mountainous area. We have to be strong enough to forge iron. We have a few acres of thin farmland at home to be able to provide food and drink. This is the foundation."
"Everything you say is empty. You have food at home, fists on your hands, and armor on your body. In any era, you can stand up and say something."
"Back then, your master was able to bring me to this mountain village and live safely because of these three things. You two were still too young."
